Lucide Icons (outline)
https://lucide.dev/
https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide

Icons vendored in this directory (SVG sources) and rasterized to assets/ui/:
  x            → assets/ui/close.png
  arrow-left   → assets/ui/back.png
  chevron-left → assets/ui/chevron_left.png
  chevron-right→ assets/ui/chevron_right.png
  chevron-up   → assets/ui/chevron_up.png
  chevron-down → assets/ui/chevron_down.png
  info         → assets/ui/info.png
  globe        → assets/ui/globe.png
  bell         → assets/ui/bell.png
  menu         → assets/ui/menu.png

PNGs are white-on-transparent exports of the outline SVGs for in-game tinting.

License: see LICENSE in this directory.

These icons (x, arrow-left, chevron-left, chevron-right, chevron-up,
chevron-down, info, bell) are derived from the Feather project and are under the
MIT License (see LICENSE). Lucide as a whole is under the ISC License.

`globe` and `menu` are Lucide-original (ISC only; not on the Feather-derived
list).
